LESSON: SIGN READING 13.2.1 INTENSIVE SIGN READING: COMPREHENSION STRATEGIES

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.2: Sign Reading 13.2.1 Intensive Sign Reading: Comprehension Strategies
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 13.2.1 Intensive Sign Reading: Comprehension Strategies, part of Strand 13 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How do you get the meaning of words from a passage?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. recognise signs of vocabulary related to the theme for effective communication,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Sign Reading 13.2.1 Intensive Sign Reading: Comprehension Strategies in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 13.2.1 Intensive Sign Reading: Comprehension Strategies together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.

4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.
